hook: Music giants AEG Presents and Danny Wimmer Presents failed a $18.9 million buyout, triggering eight years of litigation.

sections.voiceover: Music giants AEG Presents and Danny Wimmer Presents failed a $18.9 million buyout, triggering eight years of litigation.
Did AEG festival chief Melissa Ormond’s $18.9 million buy-sell offer for Rock on the Range fail?
However, that August 20, 2018 offer ignited an eight-year legal war between these two massive companies.

The dispute centers on ownership rights for major rock festivals like Carolina Rebellion and others. A jury trial scheduled for February 2027 will finally settle these competing corporate legal claims.
AEG Presents and Danny Wimmer Presents now head to a February 2027 jury trial for resolution.
